title: Preserves Jar Productivity
wikitext:
{{PreservesJarProductivity-top}} This page lists the productivity of processing [[Fruits]], [[Vegetables]], [[:Category:Mushrooms|Mushrooms]], and [[Foraging#Foraged Items|foraged items]] into [[Jellies and Pickles]] and [[Roe]] into [[Aged Roe]] or [[Caviar]] in a [[Preserves Jar]]. The products produced always sell for more than the raw input items (except in the case of gold or iridium [[Blackberry|Blackberries]] after learning the [[Bear's Knowledge]], or iridium [[Spring Onion|Spring Onions]] after learning [[Spring Onion Mastery]]), so using a Preserves Jar is almost always profitable. Jellies and Pickles are always regular quality, so the profit made from processing items is lowest when using iridium quality and highest when using regular quality items. This table does not take into account the effects of Tiller or Artisan [[Farming#Farming Skill|professions]], which reduce and increase the profit from a [[Preserves Jar]], respectively. To view the profitability for those professions, use the links at the top of the page. Note that the processing time for a Preserves Jar is always 4000 minutes, with one exception: [[Roe|Sturgeon Roe]] produces [[Caviar]] in 6000 minutes rather than 4000.
